backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (User, Store, OrderRecord, DistributorDelivery) and CRUD/query functions for a water delivery management system with role-based access control via AccessControl mixin.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state by adding the `distributorDeliveries` map to the existing state, preserving all other data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (distributor delivery management, distributor portal, store map fix) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing their purpose and key changes for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including sidebar, chart, and UI component tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vitalist Water app, setting the page title, favicon, and mounting the React app via `/src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles authentication, role-based routing (admin, staff, delivery, distributor), ICP role assignment after Internet Identity login, and renders the appropriate page per role.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable stat card component displaying a label, count, icon, and optional trend text with color-coded styling for dashboard metrics.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppSideba: Defines the application sidebar with role-based navigation items, rendering only the nav links visible to the current user's role along with a brand header and role badge.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main layout shell that composes the sidebar, a top header bar with user info and logout, and a scrollable main content area, with mobile overlay support for the sidebar.
frontend/src/components/orders/StatusBad: Small presentational component that renders a colored pill badge displaying an order status with an icon, supporting two size variants.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRCodeDisplay: Renders a QR code image for a given order ID using a URL from a utility function, with a text fallback if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRScanModal.t: Modal dialog that activates the device camera via a QR scanner hook, displays a live video preview with a scan overlay, and emits the decoded order ID once a valid QR code is detected.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides authentication state and actions (login/logout) using demo user credentials with session persistence, optionally triggering Internet Identity login, and exposing role-based boolean flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/clear functions, identity state, and login status flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including auth/profile, stores, orders, users, and distributor deliveries, wrapping actor calls with useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a water-blue color palette (light/dark), and provides utility component classes for status badges and card shadows.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DistributorDeli: Admin page for managing distributor deliveries with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog for creating/editing deliveries and a searchable table listing all deliveries.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page that lists all orders in a searchable table and allows admins to approve or cancel individual orders with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/QRManagementPag: Admin page that displays QR codes for approved orders in a searchable grid, with summary stats for total, active, and completed QR codes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: Admin analytics page that computes and displays order statistics (today/week/month counts, status breakdown, top stores) using memoized calculations over all orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StoreManagement: Admin page for managing stores with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog with map preview (OpenStreetMap iframe) and geolocation support, plus a searchable table of all stores.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Admin page for managing users with add/edit/delete functionality, role assignment (admin/staff/delivery), and a searchable table displaying users with role badges.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays order statistics (today's orders, pending, ready, out for delivery, delivered) as stat cards and shows a list of the 5 most recent orders.
frontend/src/pages/delivery/DeliveryDash: Delivery personnel dashboard showing assigned orders (Dispatched/Out for Delivery), supporting QR scan-based status transitions with GPS timestamp tracking.
frontend/src/pages/distributor/Distribut: Distributor dashboard displaying delivery assignments with truck/driver details, allowing distributors to mark truck arrival and view order status via cards with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with an email/password form that calls the auth context's login function, shows loading states for both standard and Internet Identity login, and displays demo credentials.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: QR scan page supporting three role-based stages (admin, staff, delivery) that scans order QR codes and advances order status with optional GPS capture for delivery stages.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Displays the current user's account information (name, email, role) and system info, with a sign-out button that calls the auth context logout function.
frontend/src/pages/staff/OrderCreationPa: Staff page for creating new water delivery orders by selecting a store, entering quantity/rate, and submitting; displays a success banner with the generated order ID on completion.
frontend/src/utils/geoUtils.ts: Utility module providing geolocation helpers including Haversine distance calculation, distance formatting, browser geolocation wrapper, and Google Maps URL generation.
frontend/src/utils/orderUtils.ts: Provides utility functions and types for order management, including parsing/building order metadata embedded in notes, generating order IDs and invoice numbers, encoding/decoding QR data, and mapping order statuses to display colors and icons.
frontend/src/utils/qrGenerator.ts: Generates QR code image URLs for order IDs by encoding them as base64 and delegating rendering to the qrserver.com external API.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom fonts, an extended color palette (including ocean, aqua, and semantic UI colors using OKLCH), container settings, and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state for the Vitalist Water order and delivery management system, documenting the current version, architectural constraints, known UI/permission bugs, and the full list of implemented features.
